description: Add, edit, assign, unassign, or remove logins on one owned job (jobs.shared_logins.manage). action=create takes logins: 1-200 items of {username, password, platform?, loginUrl?, notes?, assignToContractId?} (a job holds at most 500). action=update takes loginId plus any of username, password, platform, loginUrl, notes (an omitted password stays as it is; empty clears an optional field). action=assign takes loginId and contractId (an active hire on this job, from the list tool); unassign and remove take loginId only (remove keeps history; the worker loses access). Assigning notifies the worker. Passwords are WRITE-ONLY: they are encrypted at rest and never returned, echoed, logged, or stored in the idempotency receipt (only a keyed fingerprint). The result lists the affected logins without passwords. idempotencyKey is required: the same key and payload replay the original outcome; a changed payload is a 409. Requires jobs:write.

contractId.description: assign only: an active hire on this job.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the original outcome; same key + changed payload is a 409.

assignToContractId.description: An active contract on this job (from the list tool). Omit to leave unassigned.

loginUrl.description: Login link; must start with http:// or https://. Empty or null clears it.

password.description: Write-only. Stored encrypted and never returned by any tool, response, receipt, log, or error.

username.description: The username or email used to sign in.

password.description: update only. Write-only. Stored encrypted and never returned by any tool, response, receipt, log, or error.

name: opentrain_manage_job_shared_logins
